headline: Busy first morning: GATE2 plan frozen and audited, quiet-day labelling closed (0 of 4), 6 near-misses ranked; tests run tonight after the data rebuild.
bullets: New guild standard: results judged on excess t over a matched random control, not raw t, because blocking trades in a losing book looks good for free.
GATE2 (trade with the side SPY holds) plan frozen: 11 configs, lineage N 123, Testing bar 2.79 on excess t; Skeptic found 2 issues to fix first, including a timing bug.
Quiet days: 4 predictors tested, 0 pass; a quiet day cannot be labelled at 10:00 (15 configs in lineage). Low sector dispersion means a smaller day, so it is kept as a possible size dial.
Near-misses ranked: FB1 flush-chase and BURST1 latch are weak leads; counter-index entries (L6) are dead forward and retired from focus.
Observer: 47% of big movers start at 09:35, before our 09:50 entry gate, and most of the move is still ahead at 09:50; Builder will measure it tonight.
next: After 16:00 ET: rebuild the 2-year data, then GATE2, the 09:50 opening-drive measurement, SC2 cross-asset laggards and C3FR.
